subject: Audience incentive voucher — Ops approval needed
messages:
From: Sophia Hayes <sophia@devcon-events.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DevCon webinar vouchers — request for audience incentives

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the great call yesterday. DevCon is planning a June 25th virtual summit and we'd like to offer attendees a small incentive to sign up for your newsletter / product trial — largely to drive qualified leads from the webinar.

We would like to request: 150 promo vouchers (25 USD account credit each) to be distributed via our registration confirmation and post-event follow-up. We can provide an attendee list and would prefer codes that can be single-use and tied to email addresses.

Attached is a draft CSV with the registration structure we can send over (devcon_voucher_list.csv) and our standard promo terms (promo_terms.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can issue redeemable account credits and whether there are any timing or billing constraints? Also: is it possible to extend the trial window for any accounts that come in through this promo by an additional 14 days?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — creative needs to be finalized by Friday.

Best,
Sophia Hayes
Partnerships Manager
DevCon Events
Sophia@devcon-events.com

Attachments:
- devcon_voucher_list.csv (CSV stub; 150 rows expected)
- promo_terms.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophia Hayes <sophia@devcon-events.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: DevCon webinar vouchers — Ops approval needed

Hi team — forwarding request from DevCon. They want 150 $25 account-credit vouchers plus a 14-day trial extension for signups routed from their event.

Quick asks:
- Aditya: do we have promotional budget / reserve for event-driven credits like this? Any objections to single-use codes tied to emails?
- Marissa: can ops/procurement sign off on issuing credits and tracking redemptions (we should tag these in billing and GA)?

Timeline: marketing needs confirmation by EOD Friday so DevCon can finalize their landing page.

If this is OK, I can confirm scope and ask them for the final CSV with hashed emails if needed.

Thanks — K

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Partnerships (EMEA & NA)
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: DevCon webinar vouchers — Ops approval needed

Kimberly —

Short answer: probably yes, but a few constraints.

1) Budget: we have a quarterly co-marketing promo bucket for partner events. I estimate 150 * $25 = $3,750 in face value; unit economics after usage typically ~40% realized vs face due to churn/non-redemption. I can cover this from the co-marketing fund if marketing signs off on cost attribution.

2) Single-use codes tied to email: yes, we can generate codes that map to an email address and expire after one redemption. Ops will need the final CSV in our schema (hashed_email,email_hash_alg) or we can accept a hashed list from DevCon for privacy.

3) Trial extension: we can attach a 14-day extension to accounts that redeem via the promo flow, but this requires a small rule in account provisioning and a QA pass. Engineering may need a 48-72 hour lead time to push a flag to the onboarding flow.

If Marissa okays the compliance/procurement side, I'm comfortable approving the spend from the co-marketing budget. I've linked the HubSpot record for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/7892

- Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Director, GTM Partnerships
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophia Hayes <sophia@devcon-events.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: DevCon webinar vouchers — Ops approval needed

Thanks — quick procurement notes:

- I need a signed promo agreement referencing Redwood's standard partner promo terms. Sophia, can you confirm DevCon accepts our promo terms (I reviewed their document and it's close but a few timing clauses differ). If they sign our one-pager I can cut the internal approval.
- Tracking: we will generate a source tag (utm_source=devcon_2025) and a promo_code metadata field. Please ask DevCon to include the code variable in the registration confirmation email.
- Data handling: if DevCon will share full emails, we prefer SHA256 hashes to be sent. If they insist on raw emails we'll set up an SFTP transfer with limited access and immediate deletion after code issuance.

I'm fine to approve the $3,750 gross credit value once we have the signed agreement and the CSV in our schema. Attached is a quick redeem flow mock (redeem_flow.png) to confirm user experience.

Marissa
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- redeem_flow.png (image stub)

From: Sophia Hayes <sophia@devcon-events.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DevCon webinar vouchers — request for audience incentives

Thanks all — quick updates: we can sign Redwood's one-pager and will send over a SHA256-hashed email list by Friday morning. I've updated the CSV to include the hash column and removed PII (attached). Also confirming that we need the promotional codes activated by June 22 to run final tests.

A couple of clarifications for your ops team:
- Are the codes created in a single batch (150 codes) or generated on-demand via API? We prefer a single batch so we can embed codes in confirmation emails.
- For trial extension: happy to flag accounts that come from the promo on our side (we can pass a partner_flag param) if that helps engineering detect and apply the 14-day extension on redeem.

If Marissa signs off on the agreement, Aditya — please go ahead with the co-marketing allocation and Kimberly, if you can confirm production steps once codes are issued, we will finalize the landing page.

Best,
Sophia

Attachments:
- devcon_voucher_list.csv (updated; hash column included)

Note: DevCon and Redwood internal exchanges include quoted replies and forwarded headers as shown above. All parties are aware of the tracking and privacy constraints; final agreement pending Marissa's sign-off.
